description: Stations de métro et de tramway is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Liste des arrêts de métro et de tramway en novembre 2021. Chaque arrêt est listé une seule fois par type de transport (métro ou tramway), quelque soit le nombre de lignes desservies et les directions proposées (aller-retour). Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are tram, tramway, météo, arret, station. The portal shows 69 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
